title: Provider Task Identity and Restart-Safe Advanced Observation

provider_contract.documented_identity_fact: GET /tasks/{id} path id and 200 response id are both the unique Task identifier; targets contain model/output data for that Task.

pre_fix_gaps.risk: AudioShakeClient accepted a syntactically valid Task response whose response id differed from the requested path Task id.
pre_fix_gaps.impact: Wrong-job progress/output could be observed or committed after an abnormal proxy/cache/upstream response.

pre_fix_gaps.risk: parse_task_state accepted duplicate target model rows and selected the first WAV when multiple WAV outputs existed.
pre_fix_gaps.impact: Progress denominator and output identity could become ambiguous instead of failing closed.

pre_fix_gaps.risk: A fresh canonical advanced adapter required GET /models before observing an already-created Task and built output mapping only from models currently enabled on the account.
pre_fix_gaps.impact: Relaunch/reconnect could fail even when GET /tasks/{id} was healthy if model discovery was unavailable or account access changed after Task creation.

post_fix_invariants: AudioShakeClient.get_task_state requires parsed response task_id to equal the requested task_id.
AudioShake task-state parsing rejects duplicate provider model targets.
A completed target requires exactly one WAV output with an HTTPS URL containing a hostname.
Canonical advanced observation independently rebinds response task_id to the requested task_id.
Canonical advanced observation rejects duplicate provider target models before canonical mapping.
Existing Task observation maps known provider models through the checked-in catalog and does not call live GET /models.
New Task preflight/create continues to require live account discovery and enabled model access.
Unknown provider output models remain fail-closed even when observation is discovery-independent.

focused_harness.type: interface-compatible boundary harness, not repository-native checkout
covers: known model mapping independent of current access

parity.reason: A45 improves provider response correctness and restart observation but does not provide credentialed live separation, rights-cleared real-audio quality/latency, current-iPhone, or current-Moises differential evidence.
